Name: AudioFuse Control
Author: dswett
Description: Control an Arturia AudioFuse 16Rig or Studio from your Stream Deck. Dials drive monitor volume, input gain and output trim with live dB on the LCD; keys mirror mute, dim, mono, A/B, reference level and preset slots. Uses the AudioFuse Control Center HTTP API.

Actions.Name: AudioFuse Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Drive any AudioFuse parameter from a dial, with live dB on the LCD.

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mute the main monitor output. Lights red while muted.

Actions.Name: Dim
Actions.Tooltip: Drop the monitors by the device's dim amount.

Actions.Name: Mono
Actions.Tooltip: Fold the monitor output to mono for a mix check.

Actions.Name: Speaker Set A/B
Actions.Tooltip: Switch between speaker sets A and B. Shows which is live.

Actions.Name: Reference Level
Actions.Tooltip: Snap the monitor to the calibrated reference level.

Actions.Name: Preset Recall
Actions.Tooltip: Recall one of the eight preset slots. AudioFuse 16Rig only.
